name: Thenthuk
ingredients: Choice of meat (usually beef or mutton, or mixed vegetables)
instructions: 1. Knead flour with water to make a firm dough and let it rest.
2. Sauté chopped onions, ginger, garlic, and green chilies in oil.
3. Add meat (or vegetables) and cook until browned, then add tomatoes and spices.
4. Pour in water or stock and bring to a boil; add radish and cook until tender.
5. Take small pieces of dough, flatten them with your fingers, and drop them into the simmering soup.
6. Add leafy greens, season with salt and Sichuan pepper, and cook until the noodles are soft.
description: Thenthuk is a traditional comfort food primarily associated with the Monpa and Tibetan communities of Arunachal Pradesh. It is a nutritious, warming noodle soup typically enjoyed during the cold winters in high-altitude regions.
